changes.title: New: Setting Tooltips
changes.description: Added helpful hover explanations for all settings, toolbar buttons, and theme controls across the editor to explain what each option does at a glance.

changes.title: New: Graph Local Time & Manual Offset
changes.description: Added options to convert chart timestamps to local time and apply minute offsets so timeline graphs match your clock accurately.

changes.title: New: Freeze Live Values in Markdown
changes.description: The Freeze Dynamic Values tool can now detect and convert live data placeholders and formulas inside Text widgets into fixed text.

changes.title: Improved: Smooth Graph Timeline Scrolling
changes.description: Real-time streaming charts now scroll more smoothly with clean point value labels that stay firmly anchored to their data points.

changes.title: Fixed: Live Camera & Web Image Refresh
changes.description: Resolved an issue where live camera streams and web images could stop refreshing or freeze on older frames.

changes.title: Fixed: Kiosk Graph Redraw Stability
changes.description: Prevented unnecessary chart redraws during background display checks on wall-mounted kiosk screens.

changes.title: Improved: Dashboard Load & Group Interaction
changes.description: Streamlined file loading to clear previous background timers, and optimized group operations to repaint only affected widgets.

changes.title: Fixed: Homey Flow & Event Topic Aliases
changes.description: Resolved an issue where dynamic page switches, visibility rules, and audio triggers failed to fire on bare Homey event topic names.

changes.title: Fixed: Settings Reset & Preview Follower Sync
changes.description: In-place resets for typography, icons, and toolbar settings now refresh inherited preview controls and clear modified highlights immediately.

changes.title: Fixed: Inspector Menus & Pickers Cleanup
changes.description: Improved action labels, prevented duplicate dropdowns, and ensured color pickers and portaled lists close cleanly when dismissed.

changes.title: Fixed: Flow Event & Feed Updates
changes.description: Resolved an issue where widgets and feeds connected to Homey flow events were slow or failed to update.

changes.title: New: Multiple Graphs in One Widget
changes.description: You can now plot several lines or bars together on the same graph. Each graph can have its own data topic, custom name, line and fill colors, and soft gradient, automatically styled with your dashboard theme colors.

changes.title: New: Pick Live Values
changes.description: Easily browse and connect live data to your graph with the new visual picker. It detects incoming Homey Insights, data streams, and device values, showing live mini preview charts and current readings so you can set up graphs with one click.

changes.title: New: Smooth Graph Animations
changes.description: Graphs can now smoothly animate when opening a page or receiving live updates. Watch lines draw in across the screen, bars rise from the baseline, and data points smoothly glide into their new positions.

changes.title: New: Move and Resize the Legend
changes.description: The legend can now be docked along any side of the graph or dragged anywhere on your canvas as a floating panel. You can resize it from any edge or corner, and clicking a graph in the legend toggles that line on and off.

changes.title: New: Stepped Line (Stairs) Style
changes.description: Added a stepped line chart style, perfect for showing on/off switches, relay states, and thermostat temperature targets.

changes.title: New: Horizontal Bar Graphs
changes.description: You can now flip bar graphs horizontally to display values as sideways bars instead of vertical columns.

changes.title: New: Real-Time Timeline
changes.description: Duration graphs can now continuously glide forward with the real clock, giving you a live view even if sensor readings only update every once in a while.

changes.title: New: Reverse Direction
changes.description: Choose whether your timeline flows from left-to-right or right-to-left to suit your dashboard layout.

changes.title: New: Clear Numbers with Custom Limits
changes.description: Setting a custom minimum or maximum now keeps the grid lines and axis numbers neat, clean, and evenly spaced.

changes.title: New: Value Multipliers
changes.description: Multiply incoming numbers directly in the graph settings, making it easy to convert raw values like Watts into Kilowatts.

changes.title: New: Gesture Controls
changes.description: Easily navigate your dashboard using swipe gestures on touchscreens or with your mouse. You can swipe to flip between pages, loop around continuously, jump to a specific page, or trigger custom actions and flows, with built-in protection so swipes never interfere with sliders or switches.

changes.title: New: Off-Canvas Editing
changes.description: In edit mode, widgets dragged partly or completely outside the screen boundary are no longer lost or trapped. A soft tinted background clearly shows widgets placed off-screen, and their selection boxes and resize handles remain fully usable so you can easily move them back into view.

changes.title: New: Outlook and Exchange Calendars
changes.description: You can now connect published calendar links from Outlook.com and Microsoft Exchange. Recurring events stay on their exact scheduled times across Daylight Saving Time changes, and special calendar characters are cleaned up so events display neatly in your tables.

changes.title: New: Widget Info Tab
changes.description: The Widget Arsenal tab in About & Statistics is now called Widget Info. It features an interactive table showing every widget's version, category, release date, and how many times it is used on your dashboard, with expandable rows showing the full update history for that widget.

changes.title: New: Redesigned Release Notes
changes.description: The website changelog and in-app release notes now feature clean category badges, prominent titles, and easy-to-read paragraphs.

changes.title: New: Axis Font Opacity
changes.description: You can now customize font opacity (0–100%) on graph axis labels.

changes.title: Improved: Smarter Axis Steps
changes.description: Taller and wider graphs now automatically adjust the number of grid lines and values so the chart never feels crowded or empty.

changes.title: Improved: Value Labels on Points
changes.description: Numbers shown above data points now glide smoothly with the graph and space themselves out to avoid overlapping one another.

changes.title: Improved: Better Negative Values
changes.description: Negative readings can now be displayed as positive values in their own color, or hidden completely, across all chart styles.

changes.title: Improved: Smoother Curves
changes.description: Smooth line graphs now flow with natural, silky curves without sharp or jagged corners.

changes.title: Improved: Tilted Axis Labels
changes.description: You can now rotate date and time labels at an angle so longer labels fit comfortably without bumping into each other or getting clipped.

changes.title: Improved: Neat Time and Date Steps
changes.description: Timelines now line up with natural calendar units, such as the top of the hour or midnight, without repeating identical times.

changes.title: Improved: Cleaner Settings Layout
changes.description: Graph settings in the editor are organized into neat, balanced rows that are much easier to navigate.

changes.title: Improved: Presets Keep Your Data
changes.description: Applying a visual look from the preset catalog now updates the styling without erasing your configured data lines or topics.

changes.title: Improved: Kiosk & Wall Display Stability
changes.description: Improved stability and memory efficiency on 24/7 wall displays.

changes.title: Fixed: Bar Chart Labels Now Centered
changes.description: Labels and tick marks on bar graphs used to be pulled toward the far left and right edges. They now sit directly underneath the center of each bar.

changes.title: Fixed: Automatic Minimum Fits Your Data
changes.description: Automatic graph scaling used to always force the bottom of the chart to zero, even when all your numbers were much higher (such as room temperatures between 19° and 23°). The scale now properly fits your actual lowest data value.

changes.title: Fixed: Negative Values with Fixed Limits
changes.description: Setting a fixed minimum limit previously caused negative readings to disappear as blank gaps; they now correctly display as positive bars or lines in their configured negative color.

changes.title: Fixed: Widget Title No Longer Cuts Off Bottom Labels
changes.description: Adding a title label to the graph widget previously pushed the chart down and cut off the dates, times, and tick marks along the bottom edge.

changes.title: Fixed: Repeating Time Labels on the Axis
changes.description: The time axis no longer repeats identical hour or date numbers when spacing out timeline markers.

changes.title: Fixed: Zero Baseline Overlapping Numbers
changes.description: The zero baseline grid line no longer clashes or overlaps with nearby axis numbers.

changes.title: Fixed: Restored Widget Settings
changes.description: Restored several missing appearance controls in the editor, including Gradient Width on arrows, Focus Glow Color on edit boxes, Toggle Color (Off) on light grids, and Separator Gap on menus.

changes.title: Fixed: Arrow and Line Colors
changes.description: Arrow and Line widgets no longer turn invisible or lose their color when connected to smart light data topics or custom color settings.

changes.title: Fixed: Topic Page Switching
changes.description: Linking a widget's page setting to a live data topic now instantly moves the widget to the received page as soon as the value arrives.

changes.title: Fixed: Preserving Custom Canvas Sizes
changes.description: Upgrading older dashboards with custom resolutions no longer accidentally resets your screen size back to the default canvas size.

changes.title: Fixed: Toolbar Selection Clicking
changes.description: Clicking on the canvas right next to the toolbar now reliably deselects the current widget and returns you to main settings without an invisible dead zone.

changes.title: Fixed: Analog Clock Midnight Spin
changes.description: Clock hands no longer spin backwards a full turn at midnight.

changes.title: New: Fetch RSS Feed to Markdown
changes.description: Added a flow card to fetch and format single or multiple RSS feeds into clean Markdown for dashboards, and renamed the Calendar settings tab to Flow Cards.

changes.title: New: Standardized Homey Topics
changes.description: Moods, flows, and variables now use clear homey/moods/, homey/flows/, and homey/variables/ topic prefixes with full backward compatibility for existing dashboards.

changes.title: New: Flow Card: Dashboard Opened Page
changes.description: Added a trigger card that fires when a dashboard opens or navigates to a page.

changes.title: New: Flow Card: Dashboard Is Open
changes.description: Added a condition card to check if a dashboard is currently open.

changes.title: New: Flow Card: Dashboard Is Open on Page
changes.description: Added a condition card to check if a dashboard is open on a specific page.

changes.title: New: Capability & Topic Cleanup
changes.description: Added an audit tool in the app settings Configuration tab that scans all saved dashboards to find enabled Homey device capabilities and MQTT topics no longer referenced in any widget, formula, or template, letting you review them in an interactive checklist and disable them with one click to reduce memory and network traffic.

changes.title: Fixed: All-day calendar events stay on the correct day when daylight saving time changes.
Improved: State Caching
changes.description: Added cache mode options in Settings to optimize memory usage and stability on Homey.

changes.title: New: Basic Beginners Tutorial
changes.description: Added a step-by-step beginners guide to the documentation.

changes.title: New: Filter by Capability
changes.description: In Dashboard Studio configuration settings, a new capability search bar sits alongside the device name filter, allowing simultaneous filtering by device and capability with automatic section expansion.

changes.title: New: Light Grid Live Lights
changes.description: Choose lights from the topics already on your dashboard. Each light appears as a small icon with its name, live color, and brightness. Lights already in the grid start checked. Apply adds new lights and removes the ones you uncheck. Combine merges selected light devices into one tile, and Split gives a grouped light its own tile.

changes.title: New: Dashboard Statistics, Advanced Data Explorer and Diagnostics
changes.description: Live telemetry, topic inspection, and a Diagnostics page (easy for submitting error logs).

changes.title: Fixed: Several bug fixes and stability improvements.
New: Auto-Widget Gallery
changes.description: A smart widget generator integrated into both the Reset Canvas setup wizard and the Data Stream Explorer. It automatically scans all incoming Homey and MQTT topics and uses an intelligent detection algorithm to suggest the best widget type, style, icon, and unit for each live value (such as gauges for power or temperature, switches for lights and states, or sliders for dimmers). Previews are rendered live in a responsive grid with your dashboard theme, allowing you to fine-tune presets and add pre-configured widgets to your canvas with a single click.

changes.title: New: Getting Started Pointer
changes.description: On the demo dashboard, an arrow points to the Edit button, then to Reset Canvas.

changes.title: Fixed: Kiosk Stability
changes.description: Improved stability and reduced memory usage for continuous wall panel and kiosk displays running over multiple days.

changes.title: Fixed: Themes
changes.description: Themes now strictly apply visual styling without altering widget layout or behavior.

changes.title: Fixed: Responsive Columns Menus
changes.description: Clicking in grid gutters no longer prematurely closes open dropdowns, topic menus, or color pickers.

changes.title: Fixed: Formulas
changes.description: Formulas referencing the same topic multiple times now evaluate reliably.

changes.title: Fixed: Graph Height
changes.description: In Responsive Columns, a new graph with automatic cell height matches the column width instead of opening extremely tall.

changes.title: Fixed: Binding Options Formulas
changes.description: Fixed the formula edit box to allow easily removing the default value and preserved formula text when copying to the clipboard.

changes.title: Fixed: Kiosk Memory & Stability
changes.description: Resolved memory accumulation and high-frequency resource churn during multi-day continuous wall display runs. Reused clock formatting instances and text spans, streamlined camera and image refresh memory, optimized live sensor updates across gauges, battery indicators, and graphs, and eliminated lingering network timers to ensure long-term stability on kiosk screens.

changes.title: Fixed: Bound Input Topics
changes.description: Interactive widgets (switches, buttons, sliders, menus, and light grids) no longer overwrite bound topic data when clicked or adjusted.

changes.title: New: Dashboard Studio V2 Stable Release
changes.description: This release marks the official transition of Dashboard Studio V2 to public stable, introducing an overhauled editor interface with full tablet touch and stylus support, an edit-mode canvas zoom slider, a quick toolbar, and a choice between Basic and Advanced editor modes. Dashboards can now be built across three layout modes (Fixed Resolution, Scale to Fit Screen, or fluid Responsive Columns), complete with landing page navigation and automatic return after inactivity. Behind the scenes, a modernized save format, extensive performance optimizations, and reduced memory usage deliver 24/7 kiosk stability alongside a dedicated viewer mode for older tablets and iOS 12. Visual styling is expanded with frosted glass effects across 19 glass themes, instant flat/glass conversion themes, a Theme Preset Editor, a visual Theme Explorer with live theme switching via topics, and fine-grained palette adjustments (Color Tone, Intensity, Brightness, and Contrast). Container widgets gain custom polygon shapes, while text widgets add drop shadows, smooth scrolling, and markdown blinking. Homey integration expands with optional Personal API Key support to directly update Homey Logic variables, run flows, and set zone Moods from buttons, paired with an upgraded calendar engine offering streaming three-month iCal feeds and Markdown conversion flow cards. The widget ecosystem adds reusable widget presets, an integrated dashboard audio system with an in-app audio gallery, confirmation dialogs for switches and buttons, universal widget deactivation and opacity controls, linear time scales and streaming timestamps for graphs, payload formula calculations in markdown and dynamic icons, inline image gallery pickers, label hints for menu and button widgets, Open URL actions for edit boxes, and two-digit day and month formatting for clocks. Editor productivity is further enhanced with an extensible Tools menu featuring batch weblink imports for menus, link opening behavior controls, and a tool to freeze dynamic values into fixed settings, all supported by a guided canvas reset setup wizard and a fully rewritten in-app documentation library with search and beginner guides.

changes.title: New: 1.8.9
changes.description: stable: This version ships the new Text widget as the main way to show rich copy on the dashboard: Markdown (headings, lists, tables, callouts, links), Phosphor icons (including duotone in text), images, live topic values, and calendar output from Homey Flows (event lists, “today & tomorrow” style layouts, color blocks, and flexible ordering). Label widgets are migrated automatically to Text; on dense or custom layouts you may still want to check spacing, typography, and bindings once.

changes.title: Improved: In-app help updated with new Homey Flow Cards documentation for iCal-overview, send and receive, save and reload, Insight graphs, and example flows (simple flow plus serial and parallel calendar loading).
New:The Homey part of the app is now fully translated. Languages: AR, DA, DE, EN, ES, FR, IT, KO, NL, NO, PL, RU, SV.
Improved: Extra alignment space beside the icon only appears for the “icon + time + event” layout. Events without a time no longer show that gap.
Improved: Widgets that use the icon slide-out now support thin, light, bold, and duotone icon styles.
New: Icon accent theme color for duotone icons.
New: Markdown “Today & Tomorrow” list from calendar events.
New: Time-of-day grouping is optional for calendar markdown.
New: Calendar markdown event order is configurable (icon, time, and title).
Improved: When icons are on but the default calendar icon is off, column width stays aligned for time and events.
Fixed: All markdown table cells align to the top.
Improved: Load & Filter iCal flow card now includes Source ID.
New: Color blocks can now be configured by event type or calendar source.
Improved: Load & Filter iCal handles recurrence exceptions more reliably.
Improved: Load & Filter iCal uses much less memory for large calendars.
Improved: Markdown links with a caret after the URL open in a new tab; the full markdown editor can set this too.

Improved: Text widget Markdown inline icons support every Phosphor weight-Thin, Light, Regular, Bold, Fill, and Duotone-including bracket `:ph(…):` and `:ph-weight ph-name:` shorthand, with configurable primary and accent colors for duotone.
New: Text widget editor adds Markdown Icon Style (default for `:ph-icon-slug:` tokens) plus Markdown Icon Accent Color and opacity for the duotone secondary layer.
Fixed: Sliders and gauges can now fully hide their track or fill when you set the size to 0.
Improved: Calendar all-day events now display with the correct end date (no extra day).
New: Calendar setting to wrap events in colored blocks, or keep them as plain lines.
New: Calendar setting to group timed events by time of day (Night/Morning/Afternoon/Evening).
Improved: Calendar icons are now more flexible, with an option to disable the default icon.
Fixed: Calendar icon bindings can now be left empty.
New: Added four new theme “marker tint” colors for clearer categories and accents.
New: Text widget now supports simple callout blocks you can use in your content (4 color styles).
New: Text widget editor adds a quick “block callout” tool to wrap selected text.
Improved: Text widget tables now support Markdown alignment markers like `:---:` and `---:`.
Improved: Text widget table row background defaults were refreshed for a cleaner look.
Improved: Text markdown formatting reference updated in the help file.
Fixed: Selection group widgets (Switch/Button + Menu) now refresh reliably, even when the same value arrives again.
Fixed: Calendar all-day and multi-day events no longer appear one day later also in some cases.
Improved: Calendar week view ordering is now clearer and more consistent.
Improved: Recurring calendar events support more rule patterns and exceptions for better compatibility.
Improved: Calendar event ordering is now consistent across month/week/day views.
New: Load & Filter iCal can emit event type flags (timed/all-day/multi-day/recurring) for easier styling.
New: Calendar setting to show/hide icons, plus a configurable default icon.
Improved: Calendar event lines have a cleaner, consistent format (icon → time → title).
Fixed: Calendar day view now shows only the selected day.
Improved: All-day and multi-day calendar events show correctly in your chosen range.
Improved: Load & Filter iCal, custom start and end dates accept Flow tags.
Fixed: Button dynamic dimension change now works correctly when global topics are used.
Fixed: Light Grid auto-hide works correctly again.
Fixed: Graph
changes.description: turning on Show X Axis no longer collapses the chart.

changes.title: New: Added a lightweight Label widget for simple text lines with minimal overhead.
New: Redesigned the calendar engine (iCal) to handle massive files with ultra-low memory usage, preventing crashes on Homey Pro.
New: 'Load & Filter iCal' and 'Merge Calendar Events' flow cards for modular and flexible schedule management.
Improved: Added a wide range of timeframe presets for calendar filtering (Today, Yesterday, Tomorrow, This/Previous/Next Week & Month).
Improved: Native support for webcal:// links and automatic HTTP redirect handling for better compatibility with iCloud and Google calendars.
Improved: Text widget table colors and opacity now behave more predictably across table styles.
New: Added a Table Cell Padding setting to control spacing inside table cells.
Improved: Updated default table row colors for a cleaner starting look.
Improved: Scrolling in wide text tables now feels better.

Improved: Text widget table column sizing was overhauled with a new Table Column Width Mode: Align table columns (same column count), Equal Table Column Widths, Fixed Table Column Width, and Custom Column Width.

New: In Custom Column Width mode, the editor detects the number of table columns from Text Content and shows per-column width controls; 0 keeps auto width, any value above 0 sets pixel width for that column.
Improved: Overall app performance is significantly improved compared to all previous versions.
Improved: The Label widget is replaced by a Text widget with rich Markdown-formatting, icons, images, tables, and live values in the same text block.
Improved: Edit mode can show widget names on the canvas, which helps with invisible or easy-to-miss widgets; configure it in the Dashboard Environment.
Improved: Binding Options for on/off topics-a blank custom word covers all other messages; with both words set, only those two are mapped.
Fixed: A bug in the simulation driver.
Fixed: Changing Binding Options (such as the default when a topic is still empty) no longer alters the rest of the widget unexpectedly.

Fixed: When you set a topic for the current page, or show the page in a text or other widget, that value now shows up on time with local page links-no more long wait after opening the dashboard or moving between pages.
New: Binding Options (extra button next to the topic link): set a default when the topic is still empty; for on/off settings, map your own words to on or off, with Invert to flip or clear.
Fixed: Icon colors-theme colors work in the color picker again.
Fixed: Switch/Button and Menu toggles in Selection Groups: when one turns on remotely, the others switch off correctly, and group state is remembered after reloading the dashboard.
Improved: iCal calendars now include all-day and multi-day events correctly within your chosen date range.
Fixed: Timed idle behaviour in button stacks (for example auto-hide) no longer breaks when global topics refresh the dashboard.
Fixed: Light Grid auto-hide after idle no longer keeps restarting during live updates.
Fixed: Clock stays centered on older iPhones and iPads.
Fixed: Date Time Text now shows immediately after reload.
Fixed: Selecting a group from the Selected Widget menu now opens the page where that group is placed.
Improved: Groups in the Selected Widget menu now show which page they are on.
Improved: You can now click the page label and type a page number directly for faster page navigation.
New: Clock widget: Custom time, flip-clock layout, and textual time with language-aware formatting.
New: Theme Colors: Redesigned configuration, token-based theme editing, and an editor color picker with quick access to colors already used on the canvas.
New: Optional backups when you overwrite a dashboard on Homey; export an older copy from Load from Homey in the editor.
New: Widget groups: Show or hide the whole group, optional Override Page(s) for every member, dimmed backdrop behind the group, and modal-style stacking when several groups overlap.
Fixed: Graph widget horizontal grid stays inside the plot area instead of leaking past the container edge.
Fixed: Switch/Button and Menu visibility and interaction on older iOS 12 / WebKit.
New: Graph widget:Optional vertical grid lines on the left and right chart edges.
Fixed: Duplicate and paste while a group is open keep widgets in that group and visible in focus mode.
Fixed: Typing a value in the editor and then clicking a different widget no longer applies the unconfirmed value to the wrong widget.
Fixed: Horizontal gauge axis labels no longer spill past the bar (smart/strict intervals).
New: Widget Page(s) supports ranges (e.g. 1,2,5-8); insert/delete page shifts all page numbers including range bounds.
New: Optional "Current Page Output Topic" under Dashboard Environment: publishes the active page on load, reconnect, and whenever the page changes (view mode).
Improved: Menu row Output Topic matches Switch wording and dropdown layout.
Fixed: Global Font Family dropdown includes custom Google fonts (same shared list as widget editors).
Fixed: Custom fonts apply immediately for Menu and Switch/Button typography; loading now keeps your custom font list active and picks up all typography font fields.
Improved: When widget Background is off, inner effects (e.g. Switch/Button glow) are no longer clipped at the widget frame.
Fixed: Icon color picker no longer closes while you edit the color (e.g. in Chrome).
Fixed: Menu widget glow shows correctly in view mode for slide and dropdown styles when open.
Improved: Menu widget Icon Location adds Top and Bottom (icon above or below the label).
New: Menu widget optional Menu Item Width (px) for fixed-width items; long labels show an ellipsis.
New: Selection groups support "Allow empty selection" so a grouped toggle can turn off when policy allows (Switch/Button and Menu toggle items).
New: Menu toggle items support State (On/Off) for initial or unbound on/off state.
New: Menu toggle items support "Send Off When Turned Off by Group" to publish the off payload when another item in the same selection group takes over.
Improved: Redesigned the image gallery browser so it is easier to browse and pick pictures.
Fixed: Resize no longer resets the refresh timer, so the image does not reload constantly while you change the size.
Fixed: Image widgets now follow the linked topic correctly.
Fixed: Resolved an issue where Menu item icons failed to appear.
Fixed: Global label color for switches and buttons applies to button text again when you open older dashboards.
Fixed: Older dashboards with switches and buttons in groups now open with correct titles, captions, and label styling.
New: Menu widget for navigation! open pages, links, toggles, and slide-out or dropdown layouts.
New: Optional global setting to preload picture URLs across all pages for smoother page changes.
Fixed: Arrow widgets inside groups no longer shift out of place when you move or duplicate the group.
New: Image widget option 'Enable Live Refresh' to reload the picture on a timer (with adjustable interval).
Fixed: Selection group toggles ignore a tap when already ON.
Improved: Button widget with broader text styling options and several layout fixes, including horizontal alignment.
Fixed: In Selection Groups, the group can no longer end up with every button off-state stays consistent with exclusive selection.
Fixed: "Send Off When Turned Off by Group" now runs correctly when On Click is set to Go to Page.
Fixed: Fixed: Arrow widget changes are covered by undo/redo.
Fixed: The driver connection warning no longer appears on a cold page load before the link is established.
New: Added a 'Reload Dashboard' Flow action card. This allows you to remotely refresh a specific dashboard on all active devices by its name.
Improved: Renamed the 'Group / Container' widget to 'Container' to distinguish it from the new interactive grouping functionality.
Improved: Added a 'Value Horizontal Alignment' setting to the Gauge widget with intelligent positioning defaults.
Improved: Better compatibility with iOS 12 and Safari/WebKit on older devices.
New: Slider option to stream values live while dragging (optional alternative to sending only on release).
New: Added copy/paste for single widgets, multi-selections, and grouped content.
New: Added a grouping feature to organize and edit widgets together.
New: Added an undo feature with quick history controls in the editor.
New: Added snippet export/import so snippets can be shared as code.
New: Added a page navigator in the editor (`◀ Page X ▶`) for fast page stepping.
New: Added stacked widget selection using Middle Click or Alt+Click.
New: Switch/Button now supports Selection Groups, so only one toggle button in the same group can be ON at a time.
Improved: Switch/Button now sends its payload even when On Click is set to Go to Page or Open URL.
Fixed: Group moving with snap-to-grid now preserves exact relative widget positions, including manually offset widgets.
New: Added WHEN card "Dashboard Saved" with "Dashboard Name" token, triggered after confirming a successful dashboard save.
Improved: Cleaned up Switch/Button field order and labels for clearer On/Off configuration.
New: Added an optional dashboard connection warning when the active driver goes offline, with auto-hide on reconnect.
New: Direct SVG support in the Image widget (including SMIL animations).
New: Intelligent active-page tracking for Button navigation.
Improved: The 'Send Insight' Flow card now outputs data with equally spaced time intervals for perfectly consistent graph rendering.
New: Added an advanced 'Send Insight' Flow card that calculates and outputs the highest, lowest, and average values along with raw graph data.
New: You can now lock widgets! This prevents them from being accidentally moved or modified while the dashboard is in Edit Mode.
Improved: The Gauge widget now supports rotating labels for better customization.
Fixed: Resolved an issue to ensure widget label offsets behave correctly.
New: Current Dashboard Indicator

changes.description: Fixed an issue where the widget failed to display the exact word 'false' and the number '0' when bound to a dynamic text value.

changes.title: Fixed: Multi-Dashboard Sync
changes.description: Resolved a synchronization bug preventing background updates from being reflected across multiple active dashboards.

changes.title: New: Google Fonts
changes.description: Added custom Google Fonts support.

changes.title: New: Buttons and Switches
changes.description: Added directional labels.

changes.title: New: Dashboard Migration
changes.description: Introduced an automatic dashboard migration system.

changes.title: Improved: Label Positioning
changes.description: Standardized label positioning across all widgets.

changes.title: Improved: Battery Widget
changes.description: Enhanced styling and scaling.

changes.title: New: Smart Light Grid Widget
changes.description: Easily control multiple lights, colors, and brightness from a single compact panel.

changes.title: Improved: Graph Widget
changes.description: 'Manual Min' and 'Max' now strictly limit graph boundaries, and added a 'Zero Value' setting to draw bars from a custom baseline.

changes.title: Improved: Reset Canvas
changes.description: Now loads a fully configured default dashboard layout instead of a blank screen.

changes.title: Fixed: Color Display
changes.description: Fixed an issue where dark colors appeared incorrectly as white on Android tablets and phones.

changes.title: Improved: Connection Indicator
changes.description: Updated the top status indicator to correctly display 'Simulating' when simulation mode is active.

changes.title: Fixed: Editor Navigation
changes.description: Fixed an issue where the 'unsaved changes' warning would appear unnecessarily when switching pages or viewing the dashboard.

changes.title: Fixed: Graph Widget
changes.description: Fixed a bug where the title label was missing from Graph widgets.

changes.title: New: Gauge Widget
changes.description: Added precise X and Y offset settings to freely position text and values.

changes.title: New: Documentation
changes.description: Added a new 'Tips & Tricks' section featuring guides for Camera Streams and Date/Time formatting.

changes.title: Improved: Sliders & Switches
changes.description: The 'Output Topic' field now features a dropdown menu of active topics.

changes.title: Fixed: Arrow Widget
changes.description: Fixed an issue where flowing arrow animations would appear static on Apple devices (iPhone/iPad).

changes.title: Fixed: iOS Home Screen
changes.description: Fixed an issue where saving the dashboard to the iOS Home Screen would forget which specific layout to load.

changes.title: New: Initial Release
changes.description: Initial release of Dashboard Studio.
